commitProtocol.c1: single-parent direct child of baseCommit; exact c1AllowedPaths; canonical Step 1A status is IN_PROGRESS; this final Acceptance and its validator and workflow blobs become the immutable Round 7 trust root
commitProtocol.c2: single-parent direct child of C1; exact c2AllowedPaths; records exact-head C1 CI, real-provider transport smoke, and three independent critics; status remains IN_PROGRESS
commitProtocol.c3: single-parent direct child of C2; exact c3AllowedPaths; records exact-head C2 CI and a separate final judge; round status is EXTERNAL_PENDING and canonical status remains IN_PROGRESS
commitProtocol.initialMerge: exact two-parent [baseCommit,C3] merge whose tree equals C3; squash and rebase are forbidden
commitProtocol.completion: after a successful provider-bound Round 7 initial external audit, a single-parent commit on the exact initial merge may add the two completion records and apply only completionTransforms to the canonical documents; every other canonical byte remains equal to C3
commitProtocol.completionMerge: exact two-parent [initialMerge,completion] merge whose tree equals the completion commit; final reporting additionally requires its main CI and future-main external audit to succeed

downloadTransport.firstHop: authenticated GitHub API GET, Accept application/vnd.github+json, explicit API version, redirect manual, exact status 302
downloadTransport.secondHop: no Authorization or GitHub API headers, redirect error, exact status 200
bindings: exact successful job and time interval
exact artifact id and attempt-scoped name
provenance event, checkout, kit, runtime, workflow commit, tree, and blob
downloadTransport.secretBoundary: signed Location is never persisted or printed; the GitHub bearer token is never sent to the storage hop

requiredTransportTests: correct first-hop headers and manual 302 followed by an unauthenticated second-hop 200
non-302, missing Location, non-HTTPS, credentials, newline, second redirect, and non-200 fail closed
Authorization and GitHub API headers are absent from the storage request
size and digest mismatch fail closed
duplicate or unsafe ZIP members and missing, duplicate, or modified provenance fail closed

externalAuditProtocol.triggerAuthority: main-push-only reusable audit job invoked after the primary verification job through a relative same-commit workflow_call; a separate default-branch workflow_run cannot authorize completion
externalAuditProtocol.callerRunState: during the reusable audit, the exact caller run may still be in_progress with null conclusion, but its primary verification job must already be completed success and its provider-bound artifact must exist; completion evidence must later re-query the same run as completed success with the reusable audit job completed success
externalAuditProtocol.initialMode: only the exact Round 7 initial merge main-push run; after that same run uploads its primary artifact, execute the detached C1 artifact verifier against the current target repository and verify both the Round 7 C3 PR artifact and the caller run main artifact independently
externalAuditProtocol.partialFailure: attempt both verifications; reconstruct allowlisted result JSON without persisting raw verifier stdout; upload only the two exact regular non-symlink files from the mode-0700 RUNNER_TEMP boundary with if: always(); then fail an aggregate gate unless both passed
externalAuditProtocol.completionMergeMode: the exact completion merge must itself be the head of a completed successful primary main-push run whose same-run reusable future audit job succeeds with the exact C1 step ledger
externalAuditProtocol.laterDescendantMode: before auditing a later main descendant, discover and bind an earlier provider run on the exact completion merge with completed success primary and same-run reusable audit jobs; a descendant run cannot substitute for or bootstrap a missing completion-merge run, and retained artifact bytes are not required
externalAuditProtocol.futureMode: in the current main-push run, requires an earlier provider-bound successful same-run reusable Round 7 initial audit for the exact initial merge, then executes the detached C1 artifact verifier against the current target repository and verifies the caller run main artifact; the immediate completion merge re-queries the unexpired sanitized audit artifact, while later descendants bind its frozen completion identity and provider run/job ledger without requiring the historical C3 or sanitized audit artifact to remain downloadable

statusProtocol.passAuthority: completion.json added only after the successful Round 7 initial external audit

completion.completionRequired: PASS record binding the exact initial merge and SHA-256 of the external-audit record
completion.externalAuditRequired: provider-verified successful initial-main-seal primary workflow run and its same-run reusable audit job with independent PASS results for C3 and initial main
completion.sanitizedAuditArtifactRequired: exact provider id, source-run-and-attempt-scoped name, digest, and size binding for the same-run uploaded two-file sanitized evidence artifact
